Experience the Essence of Tropical Luxury with Spray Dried Mango Alphonso Powder

Tradenest Naturals offers premium spray dried mango alphonso powder, crafted specifically for high-end food manufacturing. We source only the finest Alphonso mangoes, renowned globally for their intense aroma and rich, creamy flavor. Because we use advanced spray drying technology, we preserve the natural vibrant color and nutritional profile of the fruit. This makes our powder an ideal choice for brands seeking consistent quality in every batch.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Mango Alphonso Powder?

As a leading spray dried mango alphonso powder manufacturer, we understand that consistency is vital. Our process ensures that the volatile aromatic compounds remain intact. Therefore, your end products will always carry that signature Alphonso profile. Moreover, our powder offers superior solubility compared to traditional fruit powders. This ease of integration reduces production time and improves texture in various applications. If you are looking for a reliable bulk spray dried mango alphonso powder supplier india, Tradenest Naturals provides scalable solutions. We serve everything from boutique confectionery makers to large-scale FMCG corporations. We also act as a dedicated spray dried mango alphonso powder exporter, ensuring seamless international logistics and compliance with global food safety standards.

Advanced Manufacturing Process

Our production begins with the careful selection of ripe, high-quality Alphonso mangoes. First, we extract the pure fruit pulp to ensure no additives or fillers are present. Next, we utilize a precision spray drying system. This method transforms the liquid pulp into a fine, uniform powder through rapid evaporation. As a result, we maintain the fruit's natural vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. Finally, we sieve the powder to achieve a consistent mesh size, making it perfect for automated dosing systems.

Technical Specifications and Quality Assurance

We prioritize transparency in all our technical data. Our wholesale spray dried mango alphonso powder meets strict industry benchmarks. For example, we maintain low moisture levels to prevent clumping and ensure a long shelf life. We also monitor purity levels rigorously to guarantee a 100% fruit-based ingredient. Below are the typical specifications you can expect from our facility:
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh for excellent dispersion.
  • Moisture Content: Typically below 5% for stability.
  • Purity: 100% pure Alphonso mango pulp, no added sugar or colors.
  • Solubility: High solubility in water and liquid bases.

Versatile Industrial Applications

Our powder is highly versatile. Because of its intense flavor, it is widely used in the following sectors:
  • Beverage Industry: Perfect for instant mango smoothies, juices, and flavored waters.
  • Confectionery: Ideal for mango-flavored gummies, hard candies, and chocolate fillings.
  • Dairy & Ice Cream: Adds natural flavor and color to yogurts, milkshakes, and premium ice creams.
  • Bakery: Enhances the taste of muffins, cakes, and pastries.
  • Nutraceuticals: Used as a natural flavor base in functional health foods.
